headings.rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter for headings.

body.rules: Use for all body text, inputs, lists, and dense content.

colors.rules: Swiss High-Contrast logic applied to a Dark Theme. Stark white text on nearly black background. Purely monochrome functional accents with sharp 1px borders.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-border) everywhere: on cards, headers, grid layouts.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft shadows. Use harsh flat colors or zero shadow.
visual_enhancers.radius: max 4px or sharp edges (rounded-none to rounded-sm) for a brutalist, technical feel.

layouts.bento_grid: For the Settings page, use a High-Density Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Cards stretch horizontally.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 inside cards, gap-4 to gap-6 for grids.
layouts.header: Solid background (bg-background) with a hard bottom border (border-b). DO NOT use transparent headers. Ensure it has an explicitly set z-index and doesn't overlap without spacing.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: border color lightens slightly.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn Input. Customize to have strict 1px border and strong ring-2 ring-white focus state.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or rounded-sm, high contrast background. Active/Hover states must be clearly differentiated.
components.toasts: Use sonner. Ensure they contrast with the background, e.g. white toast with black text.

motion.hover: Explicit hover states must be defined (e.g., hover:bg-white/10).
motion.transitions: Specific transitions only: transition-colors duration-200. No transition-all.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide clear focus outlines.

accessibility.contrast: Strict high contrast. Minimum 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='change-password-submit').

login_hero.description: Abstract structural geometry for the login page hero/split-screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove default generic centering styles from App.css.
Inject Chivo and IBM Plex Sans fonts via @import in index.css.
Build a modern split-screen Login page using the provided login_hero image on one side, and a 'Continue with Google' button on the other.
Create an Authenticated App Shell featuring a top header with the product name and a user avatar dropdown. Use Shadcn DropdownMenu.
Build a Settings/Account page utilizing a strict High-Density bento grid style.
On the Settings page, include a 'Profile' read-only section and a 'Change Password' form.
The Change Password form must include fields for current password (if set, mock logic for now), new password, and confirm new password with inline validation.
Integrate sonner for success/error toasts upon submission of the change password form.
Ensure the change password endpoint logic is wired to POST /api/auth/change-password.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, or strict grid borders if using brutalist style.
NEVER center align the app container in css.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Examine existing components to understand patterns.
Include data-testid for ALL interactive elements.
